title: allears.summarize/v1 result envelope
description: summarize's --json result envelope (issue #63). Success (every preset succeeded): the one JSON document on stdout; 'output' is present only when exactly one preset ran. Failure: the last line of stderr, still carrying per-preset 'outputs' so partial success (2 of 3 presets) is expressible; stdout stays byte-empty and the exit is non-zero unless all presets succeeded. Additive keys may appear in later revisions, so consumers must ignore unknown keys (additionalProperties stays permissive on purpose).

path.description: Absolute path of the written summary; absent when the preset failed.

output.description: Present only when exactly one preset ran: that preset's summary path.

exit_class.description: The exit-code taxonomy label (issue #61); 'unclassified' for any code outside it.

outputs.description: Present when at least one preset was attempted: per-preset results, so a partial failure still names what was written.
